The 2026 PGA Championship, the 108th edition, will be held from May 14–17, 2026, at the Aronimink Golf Club in Newtown Square, Pennsylvania, a suburb of Philadelphia. As one of golf's premier majors, it returns to the historic Donald Ross-designed course, attracting top professionals for a premier championship. Key Details for 2026 PGA Championship Location: Aronimink Golf Club, Newtown Square, PA. Dates: May 14-17, 2026. Significance: It is the first PGA Championship in Philadelphia since 1962. Tickets & Access: Free grounds access for military members and their guests is available, along with standard tickets via SeatGeek. SeatGeek Onsite Experience: The event will feature a 50,000 square foot PGA Shop. PGA Shop Accommodation: Local homeowners can rent homes to visitors through Rent Like A Champion.
